composition_variation: Create a bright sports-lifestyle anime illustration of Rock Lee after a peaceful morning jog. Preserve his neat black bowl haircut, very thick eyebrows, round attentive eyes, and earnest cheerful expression. Dress him in a fully covering green tracksuit and white running shoes. He stands beside a low park bench, gently stretching one shoulder with both feet firmly planted. Keep the gesture simple and friendly. Use lemon sunrise, emerald trees, terracotta path curves, and a large clear sky gradient. Design for native 1024x1536 portrait format: important forms inside x158..866, faces inside x240..784. Leave the upper 28 percent quiet for the lock-screen clock. Use an original composition, no copied frames or promotional layout, text, logos, UI, weapons, fighting, extra characters, or distorted anatomy.
